* v4.10.3 plan and findings: one story

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 1: the opener hook and the listed asks (R1, R2, R3)

The also-open lead opens with the grant total and the soonest investor
program closing within 30 days (its own amount, kind and close, never in a
total), names the draft's first round and how many come after, and its
repeat names them too. A yes carrying round 1's answers banks them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 1 fix round 1: one asks function, done only when answered, one investor word

programAsks is the one function the ready set, the also-open lead and the
path draft count and ask from (full record); the lead reads its round per
reply. draftYes marks done only the fields that got a value when the
answers are split. Only the lead's start ask banks a yes's answers; a yes
that answers everything shows the draft body with a first-time prepare
note. Investor programs read 'an accelerator' in the ready lines, and the
repeat falls back to the count when a round phrase reads as a question.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 2: no narration, one score (R4, R5)

R4: UPDATING_LINE and UPDATING_SAID are gone from builder text; numbers are
still left out while updating and the agent keeps numbers_note. The merge
gate's noRecord keys off numbers_updating. A standing question while updating
gets the existing no-score answer.

R5: the Monday block shows the live score and streak (readStanding, the same
source as the standing fact) under "This week", with its change since last
week's final; last week's number never shows. Standing.soFar, its "so far this
week" copy and the moment_score said key are removed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 2 fix round 1: no empty Monday table, page answer while updating, one week count, rises only

- mondayReply emits no table when it has no rows.
- A builder with a score asking where they stand while updating hears
  "Your score and streak are on your page: {page}."; one with none keeps
  the copy before a score.
- The X weekly post uses the live streak, the block's count.
- The block shows only a rise ("up N"), never "down N".
- MondayFacts documents the email and reply meanings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 3: one ask (R6)

The Monday block asks nothing. The first settled reply of the week that shows it
adds last week to the page itself (approveWeek, the action a yes to the retired
MOMENT_ASK took), says "Last week is on your page." and rides above the reply,
whose one easy reply stays the program ask (apply, the also-open lead, the path
move). share leaves stateAsk; MOMENT_ASK, SHARE_WHY and SHARE_NOTE are gone. A
failed add says nothing about the page. An old pending share yes hands off to
find's program ask.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 3 fix round 1: consent-safe auto add on the first settled reply, builder-only stats, retry on failure

The Monday add is approveWeek 'auto': it never writes approved_summary, so a
private repo's summary stays off the page until the builder's own yes. The add
runs on the first settled reply of the week (after the connect offer is
answered), add then claim, so a failed add retries; the block is said once
where it fits (standing_seen.moment_due). Stats exclude 'auto'. An old share
no hands off to find; a shared client hears "Okay.". openShare removed. The
block drops its link when the reply's step carries one. Concurrency, retry,
path-move and consent tests.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 3 fix round 2: a connect no withholds the Monday add, no private quote, claim then add

A no to the connect offer is kept (connect_no) and the Monday add never runs
while it stands; an explicit yes lifts it (connect_ok), and builders from
before with no explicit approval fail closed. The block never quotes a summary
that needs consent. The email page yes takes an automatic week over. No add on
"show more" or over a held question. builder_points.via allows 'auto'. The add
claims first and releases on a thrown error; the block is said once a week per
builder (moment_said).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 3 fix round 3: "You shipped last week." only with ship facts, atomic connect no

The Monday block is about last week: with no summary it says "You shipped last
week." only when the week has ship facts, else no such sentence. The connect
no (or yes) marker is written in the same UPDATE that closes the offer, so a
failed write closes nothing and never fails open.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 4: walk M (the Monday probe), and the program ask wins over the lighter asks

The replay gains WALK=M: the clock pinned to a Monday after 15:00 UTC, the refresh
held by a gated reader, then find (updating), score, find, with its own gate.

Walk M found the updating Monday find ending on the check-in ask instead of the
Base ask (R6). alsoLeadDue (the lead's pure eligibility) keeps the check-in, wallet,
token, new repo and titles asks out of the also-open lead's slot.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 Task 4: docs for Tasks 1 to 4, and R7 (Arbitrum keeps both tags)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 final fixes: 7-day lead hold, builder-action stats, no auto points, honest Monday opener

- F1 (owner): the also-open lead holds the lighter asks only 7 days from first offered (standing_seen.also_first,
  ALSO_HOLD_MS); then they take their turns and the lead shows in its slot.
- F2 (owner): activated and weekly_active count any explicit builder action (stats.ts builderActed: own approvals,
  banked answers, applications told, draft yeses, check-in answers); shared only real shares; new weeks_on_pages.
- F4 (owner): an automatic add awards no points; the builder's later confirmation does.
- F3, F9: "You shipped last week." and "Nice work." only with ship facts, in the reply and the weekly email.
- F5: an automatic week still reads "Not yet confirmed" on the page and feed (weekConfirmed).
- F6 docs, F7 owner_people.last_approved_week excludes 'auto', F8 comment, F10 draft printed once, F11 no period
  after the URL, (c) investor-clause test.
- Docs: architecture-guide.md, code-map.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* v4.10.3 final re-review: the email keeps Looks right on an automatic week; weeks_on_pages leaves hidden weeks out

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

# EarnKit

Where agents earn. EarnKit gives AI agents live builder programs to build for.

## Connect an agent

The full guide is at [earnkit.com/docs](https://earnkit.com/docs).

MCP server URL: **`https://earnkit.com/mcp`**. The agent connects; the builder signs in with X
("Sign in with X") in the browser that opens at install.

- **Grok Bot:** add the URL as an MCP connector.
- **Claude Code:** `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user earnkit https://earnkit.com/mcp` (user scope: EarnKit works in every folder), then open Claude Code, type `/mcp`, pick earnkit, choose Authenticate.
- **Cursor:** the one-click "Add to Cursor" button on earnkit.com, or in `~/.cursor/mcp.json`: `{"mcpServers": {"earnkit": {"url": "https://earnkit.com/mcp"}}}`
- **Codex:** `codex mcp add earnkit --url https://earnkit.com/mcp`, then `codex mcp login earnkit`.
- **Muse:** add the URL as a custom integration.
- **OpenClaw:** `openclaw mcp add earnkit --url https://earnkit.com/mcp --transport streamable-http`, then `openclaw mcp login earnkit`.
- **Any other MCP client:** add the URL as a remote server.
- **Clients that only run local (stdio) servers:** `npx -y mcp-remote https://earnkit.com/mcp`

Agents that work today: Grok Bot, Muse, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex.

Then ask: "What can I earn?"

Tools (five): `find` ("what can I earn?": the builder's standing, matching projects and open programs, or one
program and its guide), `score` (the builder's score and how to move up), `prepare` (the coach and the draft),
`confirm` (the builder's yes: the entry, its token and the submit kit) and `tell` (what the builder said:
submitted, updates, statements). The v2.9 names (`list_programs`, `get_program`, `prepare_submission`,
`confirm_entry`, `record_submission`, `launch_token`, `tell_earnkit`) are hidden aliases until 2026-11-09
(`lib/earnkit/aliases.ts`; `/mcp` rewrites them and logs each use).

Entering (v2.4): `prepare` returns `show_to_builder`, the one block the builder confirms,
prize first. For EarnKit's own campaigns `confirm` is the entry: contracts deployed from
the payout wallet, or from the agent's own wallet with `deployer_signature` (an EIP-191 signature of
"EarnKit entry: <program_id> github.com/<owner>/<repo> <payout wallet> <contracts, sorted, comma-separated>", lowercase); every problem comes back at once.
Scoring, the 48-hour public review and the payout run on their own (`POST /api/cron`, called hourly
by GitHub Actions). A token on tokens.fun launches with the builder's yes at confirmation;
`confirm` with `project_id` retries one later. The rules an agent needs are in the tool descriptions.
Sponsor campaigns are archived (v2.12): see `archive/sponsor-campaigns/README.md`.

## Layout

```
apps/frontend/     Next.js: landing page, hosted MCP server (/mcp), OAuth, all EarnKit logic
programs/          one JSON file per program (see programs/README.md)
docs/              architecture guide, code map, design docs
```

## Local setup

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev          # http://localhost:3000
pnpm test
```

Env (`apps/frontend/.env.local`): `DATABASE_URL`, `EARNKIT_AUTH_SECRET` (any random string locally).
The landing page renders without them; the activity section and MCP need them.

## Deploy

Railway (`apps/frontend/railway.toml`). Each deploy runs `pnpm db:migrate` first.
Production also sets `EARNKIT_URL=https://earnkit.com`.

[profile.default]
src = "src"
test = "test"
out = "out"
libs = ["lib"]
solc = "0.8.28"
evm_version = "cancun"
optimizer = true
optimizer_runs = 10000
remappings = [
  "@openzeppelin/contracts/=lib/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/",
  "forge-std/=lib/forge-std/src/",
]

[fuzz]
runs = 1000

[invariant]
runs = 256
depth = 64
fail_on_revert = false

/**

/** v2.10.1 (I1): an address that is a shared Base contract, never a builder's own. Pure. */
export const sharedContract = (address: string): boolean => SHARED_BASE_CONTRACTS.has(address.toLowerCase());

/**
 * v2.12.1: the shared contracts a coin is bought from (pools, routers, aggregators). A transfer out
 * of one is a buy; one out of a locker, vault, airdrop, presale or the dev buy is not a trade.
 */
const TRADE_VENUES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  '0x498581ff718922c3f8e6a244956af099b2652b2b', // Uniswap v4 PoolManager
  '0x6ff5693b99212da76ad316178a184ab56d299b43', // Universal Router (v4)
  '0x3fc91a3afd70395cd496c647d5a6cc9d4b2b7fad', // Universal Router (v3)
  '0x000000000022d473030f116ddee9f6b43ac78ba3', // Permit2
  '0x2626664c2603336e57b271c5c0b26f421741e481', // SwapRouter02
  '0x4752ba5dbc23f44d87826276bf6fd6b1c372ad24', // v2 router
  '0xdef1c0ded9bec7f1a1670819833240f027b25eff', // 0x Exchange Proxy
  '0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582', // 1inch v5 router
  '0x111111125421ca6dc452d289314280a0f8842a65', // 1inch v6 router
  '0xcf77a3ba9a5ca399b7c97c74d54e5b1beb874e43', // Aerodrome router
]);

/** v2.12.1: a pool or router a coin is bought from (a subset of SHARED_BASE_CONTRACTS). Pure. */
export const tradeVenue = (address: string): boolean => TRADE_VENUES.has(address.toLowerCase());
